text:
maria: Heads-up — we're hitting ALB target group limits in us-west-2 for our private endpoints. Canary deployment for the new GPU pool can't register because we can't create more target groups. Need to open a quota increase with AWS.
kevin: How many target groups are we at vs the quota? can you paste the error from the controller?
maria: We're at 62/75 target groups in us-west-2 (per-account ALB target group limit). The ingress controller logs: `Failed to create targetgroup: TooManyTargetGroups: You have reached the maximum number of target groups for your account in this region.`
raj: Oof. Is this coming from lots of tiny services or leftover test ALBs? Any orphaned target groups we can delete?
maria: Mixed. A few ephemeral stacks from recent perf tests plus per-deployment internal ALBs created by k8s services with `service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-type: external`. I've identified ~8 stale TGs to delete, but that'll only free a bit.
lina: For quick mitigation we could convert some internal services to have shared target groups via the new shared-ingress annotation. But longer term we should request quota bump. Suggesting request to 300 TGs for us-west-2.
kevin: Sounds reasonable. Also check PrivateLink/interface endpoint ENI quotas — we may hit ENI per-AZ limits when we add more interface endpoints for model-serving VPC endpoints.
maria: Good call. ENI usage in the VPC is at 85% of the soft limit in us-west-2a (we're at 255/300). Need to request EC2 Network Interfaces increase to 600 for the account in that region or request increase per-AZ if AWS supports.
raj: I'll draft the AWS Support case. Which service codes/quotas to request? We need: (1) Elastic Load Balancing - Application/Target Group limit increase, (2) EC2 - Elastic Network Interfaces quota, (3) VPC Endpoints (Interface) quota maybe? Also NLB ephemeral IP quotas if we create many NLBs.
maria: Yep: elasticloadbalancing quota for target groups to 300; ec2 eni quota to 600; and com.amazonaws.vpce.interface quota bump to 200. Also mention we need expedited review due to blocked canary for GPU serving.
kevin: Add business justification: internal PLG customers need steady inference capacity for canary; blocking deploy impacts bookings. Include expected growth: 3x TGs in next 6 months.
lina: I'll attach the cluster / controller logs and list of stale TGs to delete to the support case.
aws-support-bot: AWS Support case created: case-id #18974123. Initial response ETA 24 hours. Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?caseId=18974123
sre-oncall: Thx. After case is created, please also run this to verify current quotas: `aws service-quotas get-service-quota --service-code elastic-load-balancing --quota-code L-12345678 --region us-west-2` or list all with `aws service-quotas list-service-quotas --service-code elastic-load-balancing --region us-west-2`.
maria: Filing the internal change: I'll also open infra ticket to consolidate ALBs and convert some k8s services to use shared target groups as a medium-term fix. For now, proceeding with requested quota numbers in the support case and asking for expedited review. :pray:
kevin: Thanks. Ping here when AWS approves so we can proceed with canary.
